title: nf-core/circdna pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

input_bam.errorMessage: BAM file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.bam'
input_bam.help_text: Optional raw BAM input for long-read (PacBio/ONT) samples when entrypoint is subreads or hifi_bam.

entrypoint.errorMessage: Entrypoint must be one of: cleaned_fastq, raw_fastq, subreads, hifi_bam

lane.help_text: Optional lane identifier used to distinguish multiple sequencing lanes for the same sample.

datatype.errorMessage: Datatype must be one of: gdna, eccdna
datatype.help_text: Sample datatype: gdna (background/WGS) or eccdna (detection). Routing field; Integrated Mode was removed (scoring lives in eccdna.smk).

platform.errorMessage: Platform must be one of: illumina, pacbio, ont
platform.help_text: Sequencing platform. Determines the pre-processing chain per row (mixed tables are allowed).

assay.errorMessage: Assay must be one of: wgs, circleseq, rca, ciderseq, enriched
assay.help_text: Experimental type → engine set. Short-read defaults: gdna→wgs, eccdna→circleseq. Long-read must be explicit (or backfilled with --assay). Illumina+RCA must be written as circleseq.

pair.help_text: Study grouping key (e.g. bioproject). Used by ECCsplorer clu joins (only illumina circleseq ⋈ illumina wgs with the same pair) and kept for downstream eccdna.smk.

concatemer.errorMessage: Concatemer must be true or false
concatemer.help_text: Long-read RCA only. true → TideHunter unit/asm runs; false (linearized RCA / T7 debranching) → TideHunter skipped.

read_type.errorMessage: read_type must be one of: hifi, clr, ont, pe, se
read_type.help_text: Alignment preset. Defaults: ont→ont, pacbio→hifi, illumina→pe/se. CLR (PacBio RS / non-HiFi Sequel) must be written explicitly.

enrichment.errorMessage: enrichment must be one of: none, circleseq, mobilome, ciderseq, t7, exov, other
enrichment.help_text: Annotation only — does not route. Describes the enrichment method.

protocol.errorMessage: Protocol must be one of: short_read, long_read
protocol.help_text: DEPRECATED: legacy column, only mapped to a platform fallback (short_read→illumina); no longer a routing key.
